extDescription.message: Shows your bookmarks in Chrome's side panel, synced peer-to-peer by an embedded background daemon — no central server.

connectionSectionHint.message: This extension talks to reading-list-syncd, a small background daemon bundled with it (see the project's README for install instructions) — there's no port or secret to enter here anymore.

crawlToggleHint.message: When a page's title/image can't be read directly (side panel "+" button, or a right-click on a link), fetch the page itself in the background to fill them in. Grants access to read pages on any site you bookmark.

statusConnectionFailed.message: Couldn't reach the sync daemon. See the README for how to install and start it.

fetchErrorText.message: Couldn't reach the local sync service.

addCurrentTabTitle.message: Add this page to Reading List

addCurrentTabCommand.message: Add current tab to Reading List

notifyErrorBody.message: The local sync service rejected the link. Try again or check your settings.

notifyInvalidBody.message: This tab doesn't have a valid http/https URL.

notifyNotConfiguredBody.message: The reading-list-syncd background service isn't running or isn't installed — see the extension's README for setup.

notifyDeleteErrorBody.message: The local sync service rejected the request. Try again later.
